facts.fact: Kalisho Info reports that Uganda's Judiciary rolled out the Electronic Court Case Management Information System (ECCMIS) across the Cluster Eight courts of the Mbarara High Court Circuit on 18 May 2026, after a national launch in 2022 and earlier clusters.
Kalisho Info reports that ECCMIS lets litigants and lawyers file documents electronically through a public portal.
Kalisho Info reports that ECCMIS gives real-time case status updates and the public portal gives access to case information across all jurisdictions.

systems.system: Electronic Court Case Management Information System (ECCMIS)

facts.fact: Kalisho Info reports that ECCMIS integrates online payment of court fees, fines, bail and deposits, in service in the Judiciary of Uganda's courts including the Cluster Eight rollout of 18 May 2026.
